data.long_meaning: In Greek, Margareta is derived from Margarites, which means 'pearl'. This name signifies the preciousness and beauty of one who bears this name. In Christianity, it is believed to be a variant of Magdalene, a name associated with Mary Magdalene, a significant figure in the New Testament.
